news.title: Perpetual futures could become crypto's next ETF moment
news.summary: John Palmer, head of derivatives at Kraken, said he expects sophisticated traders to lead adoption of newly approved U.S. perpetual futures, with broader institutional participation likely to follow over time.

news.title: Saylor to Musk: Thanks to you, 25% of 'Mag8' firms now hold bitcoin
news.summary: "Thanks to you, 25% of the Mag8 now holds bitcoin on the balance sheet," Saylor wrote on X, congratulating Musk on SpaceX's historic IPO debut.

news.title: Crypto should adopt the best of centralization, says LMAX CEO
news.summary: As digital assets mature the industry should borrow more from traditional market infrastructure, especially credit, clearing and collateral systems, David Mercer argues.

news.title: Ripple wants AI agents to pay in XRP and RLUSD. The market is still mostly USDC
news.summary: The XRPL AI Starter Kit gives developers tools for agent payments, but early x402 activity has clustered on Base and Solana. Ripple’s bet is that XRPL’s speed, low fees and RLUSD can win a piece of that flow.

news.title: Top cryptographers can't agree on Bitcoin's biggest quantum question
news.summary: A Coinbase-convened panel says Bitcoin should start preparing for quantum attacks now, but declines to take a position on whether millions of vulnerable coins, including many linked to Satoshi Nakamoto, should eventually be frozen.

news.title: Anthropic's pre-IPO shares fall as U.S. government shuts down its most powerful AI model
news.summary: A jailbreak report prompted Washington to pull Fable 5 and Mythos 5 from all users. Anthropic complied but pushed back hard, saying the finding sets a standard that would halt the entire AI industry.

news.title: Bitcoin steadies above $63,000 as its worst week in months got a late macro rescue
news.summary: A tiny Strategy sale raised a bigger question about Saylor’s never-sell stance, while easing Iran fears, and a strong SpaceX debut helped risk assets recover.

news.title: SpaceX IPO scramble reveals difference between tokenizing a stock and getting one
news.summary: Crypto platforms promised early access to the blockbuster SpaceX IPO through tokenized shares. The problem wasn't technology, but getting the actual stock.

news.title: My elderly mother and I own a home together. Will Medicaid force its sale?
news.summary: “My sister thinks Medicaid will take the house my mom and I own together.”

news.title: SpaceX employees now have enough wealth on paper to buy every home in this Texas city
news.summary: 2025 set an all-time high for first-time buyers who used financial assets to buy a home or fund a down payment, according to the National Association of Realtors.

news.title: I’m 55 and earn $100,000. Should I take a $2,900 monthly pension — or $2,200 with 3% annual hikes?
news.summary: “I plan to continue working until age 60.”

news.title: The rich keep spending money on ‘unapologetic luxury’ — and it’s raising prices on everyday goods for everyone
news.summary: The wealthy are unfazed by inflation, and that could complicate the Fed’s ability to fight it.

news.title: Defaults in debt markets are starting again, warns Pimco. Here’s the bond giant’s game plan.
news.summary: Investors should increasingly seek out fixed income to anchor portfolios as equity valuations look stretched, says Pimco.

news.title: ‘I feel like he may be taking advantage of us’: Our adviser pushes annuities after we already said no. Do we fire him?
news.summary: “I feel like he may be taking advantage of us.”

news.title: ‘It seems too good to be true’: At a steak-dinner retirement seminar, the guy said annuities can outperform the market. Is that true?
news.summary: “He claimed that fixed-rate annuities are the sparkly, rainbow-fairyland of investments.”
